workspace.description: Write the root configuration the engine reads into a repository that has none.

library.description: Create a TypeScript library of the workspace, publishable on request.

make-publishable.description: Give a library the targets, manifest fields, README and e2e project a published package needs.

rename.description: Rename a project and carry the new name into everything that refers to it.

move.description: Relocate a project under another directory and bring its names, aliases and references along.
